title: ivy template typechecking fails with "ERROR in TypeError: Cannot read property 'getStart' of undefined"

labels.name: area: compiler
labels.description: Issues related to `ngc`, Angular's template compiler

milestone.title: Backlog

body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/compiler-cli ### Is this a regression? Not sure, it might have worked in previous betas ### Description When I try and run ivy on my app it fails to run template typechecking. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://github.com/mattlewis92/angular-calendar/tree/try-ivy-v2 ## 🔥 Exception or Error
